detection.classification: Commit author on plugin-examples/* branch = automated, other = manual
detection.plan_healing_finding: No manual README edits detected across any target repo — all automated via template

preservation_protocol: 1. If README has managed-section markers: only replace content between markers
2. If README has NO markers (current state): full replacement safe, but introduce markers
3. If manual content detected outside markers: preserve byte-for-byte, document in evidence
4. Before/after snapshots saved for every modification
5. Idempotency proof: re-running sync produces zero diff

managed_section_convention.introduction: Add to Jinja2 template. Content outside markers in existing README is preserved.
